candidates.locator: Outline of the Faith (BCP p. 857) — Prayer and Worship: Q. What is corporate worship?
candidates.rationale: The catechism directly asserts holiness as an attribute of God in the context of corporate worship.
candidates.chunk_text: What is corporate worship? In corporate worship, we unite ourselves with others to acknowledge the holiness of God, to hear God’s Word, to offer prayer, and to celebrate the sacraments.
